actualAuthorReading: All23complete query objects/24entries/57sense records/36forms actually read before freeze, including all restrictions/notes/attributions;19Wikipedia pseudo-definitions not lexical evidence. Root21queries returned in4bounded complete groups(6/6/7/2); both additional paper-comparison objects returned in full.
adjudication: 鞄usually-kana lexical tag actually present. Keep canonical鞄/かばん/gairaigo and bothかばん/カバンteaching. Chinese and Dutch borrowing proposals remain uncertain; kanji spelling does not prove inherited native origin. Basket lexical gloss does not make this the default word for every container. Paper-bagWikipedia mapping is not lexical proof.
財布adopts wallet/coin-purse money-container meanings, not a generic handbag. Material association財+布is not a claim that wallets must be cloth. 千円inside is an amount, not the wallet's price.
鍵adopts key, lock and qualified clue/key-to-success senses, not a keyboard/piano key. Additional captured鑰/Katakanaforms are not automatically adopted.

新聞publication/newspaper-paper versusニュース/報道news content is preserved; no manufactured synonymy from Englishnews. 雑誌means a periodical rather than an individual article. Smallっinざっしlengthens the following fricative, not a separately pronouncedつ.
ノートadopts notebook/exercise-book and lesson-note senses1–2. Captured musical-note/laptop senses are not adopted. Note-taking and physically taking a notebook remain context-dependent constructions.

手紙adopts addressed written message/letter, not paper material or everyemail, and does not require handwriting. 葉書adopts postcard sense1/kana spellings, not captured memo/card sense2 or uncommon graph variants. 切手adopts postage-stamp sense1, not merchandise certificate.

鉛筆ordinary pencil is distinguished from every pen-shaped object. Modern ordinary graphite-pencil material statement does not require every colored pencil to contain graphite. Counterformsいっぽん/にほん/さんぼんretained.

ペンqueryincludes ordinary pen plus independent same-readingＰＥＮorganization entries/JMnedict attribution; organization material is not adopted as a stationery sense. ボールペンactual lexical sourceEnglishball penandWasei tag support Japanese-made formation, not a pen for playing ball.

万年筆adopts fountain-pen mechanism and selectedまんねんひつ; capturedまんねんぴつ/まんねんふでare real but unadopted, not declared impossible. The selectedひつversus鉛筆ぴつcomparison is scoped to the taught readings, not an absolute ban.

紙adopts material/sheet and existing counter/compound teaching. Separate actual髪/かみand神/かみqueries support homophone comparison; no pitch data inferred from kana, no hair/deity cards adopted. Slang/archaic神senses are not adopted.
封筒is the envelope container even empty/unsealed, not its contents or a guaranteed postage-paid object. カメラnoun/instrument/direct-object distinction retained; it legitimately has3sourceH2sections.

写真adopts photo/photography and qualified obsolete moving-picture mention; image spelling/mnemonic does not prove truth or lack of editing. 地図is geographic representation, including digital maps, not land itself or every picture.

フィルムphotographic and qualified thin-material scope retained; whole-sizeフイルムvariant actually captured. レコードretains phonograph disc plus qualified sport/data-structure senses, not every recording verb. テープretains fastening/recording strips, nonverbal noun behavior and plainカセットcassette/game-cartridge comparison.
All21frozenN5classifications retained, including mixed APIlevels for鍵/ペン; no inferred new syllabus coverage. Other API senses/forms are evidence, not automatically learner adoption.
